steps.decide: Which plan differences are decisions and which are noise, then remove the noise
The default plan and how it is marked without relying on colour or scale alone
How price, currency, billing period and trial terms are stated exactly
Mobile reading order and the reason for it

rules.statement: The comparison lists only differences that change a purchase decision; identical benefits appear once, outside the grid.
The recommended plan carries a text label as well as visual emphasis; emphasis alone is not a recommendation.
Price, currency, billing period and trial end are literal text; no figure is computed at render time that a user cannot read.
On narrow viewports the recommended plan comes first in reading order, not the cheapest, and the order is stated.

motion.noneReason: selection navigates to checkout; an animation would delay a commercial action

transitions.trigger: checkout opens or the selection is abandoned

motion.noneReason: the destination document is already at its default state

sections.intent: Support one purchase decision by showing only the differences that change it.
nicheDifferences: Usage-based pricing needs an estimator, not a grid
Enterprise tiers need a contact route instead of a fourth column
styling: Recommendation marked with text as well as emphasis
Prices share alignment and numeral style
Feature rows justified to the grid, not to the column
a11y: Comparison readable as a list in DOM order
Price changes announced if billing toggles
responsive: Recommended plan first in reading order on narrow viewports
Rows become per-plan blocks instead of horizontal scroll
copy: Price, currency and period stated literally
Trial end stated as a date or explicit duration
No savings claim without a registered figure
alternatives: A single recommended plan with an upgrade path is legitimate
A contact-sales column is preferable to a fourth price tier

references.label: Project convention: differences that change a decision only (T0405)

failureCases: Computed price that disagrees with checkout
